archive_level_missing_components.detail: Required by component.py and contract.py and by the 100-item gate, but not bundled or otherwise available in the supplied archive.
The prior README claimed it was carried verbatim, but it is absent; 4.2.0 removes the inaccurate claim rather than fabricating the source.
CHECKLIST C031 requires an approved Dandelion implementation/version/specification; no Dandelion artifact or version pin is present.
No pyproject.toml/setup.py/requirements lock declares how to install this package and its pk_core dependency reproducibly.
No sealed evidence ledger or PK_GATE_RESULTS artifact is included, and the gate cannot be regenerated without pk_core.
No executable integration with PLN-04, INV-26, PLN-05, or GAP-09 is included.
No CI workflow runs tests, optimized-mode checks, schema validation, security scans, or release gates.
No LICENSE/NOTICE or package license metadata is present, so redistribution terms are unspecified in this archive.
No accountable owner, CODEOWNERS, support contact, or escalation path is defined.
No benchmark/soak/fleet, fault-injection, fuzz, or comprehensive adversarial test harnesses are included.
